newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Student violence shuts Bangladesh university.
newsitem.headline: Student violence shuts Bangladesh university.

text.p: Authorities closed Bangladesh's Islamic University in northwestern district of Kushtia on Thursday after at least 150 people were injured in clashes between rival students over a soccer match, police said.
They said battles erupted between supporters of the ruling Awami League and the fundamentalist Jamaat-e-Islami, with both sides using revolvers, sawn-off rifles, home-made bombs and hockey sticks.
More than 90 students were admitted to hospitals with multiple injuries while about 60 more had to receive first aid, hospital sources said.
University authorities ordered the 2,500-student university to close indefinitely and told students to vacate their dormitories immediately. No further details were immediately available.
